title: Surface Fairness, Deep Bias: A Comparative Study of Bias in Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It is mentioned as a protected characteristic in the introduction and as an explicit limitation of the study, noting that religious factors were not explored.
findings: The paper has no findings related to religion, as it explicitly states in the 'Limitations' section that religious factors were not part of the experimental scope.
